mapper.select: SELECT account.`id` AS 'id', account.`user_id` AS 'userId', account.`channel` AS 'channel', account.`status` AS 'status', account.`expire_time` AS 'expireTime', account.`lock_time` AS 'lockTime', account.`lock_reason` AS 'lockReason', account.`create_user_id` AS 'createUserId', account.`create_time` AS 'createTime', account.`update_user_id` AS 'updateUserId', account.`update_time` AS 'updateTime' FROM bds_account account WHERE account.`id` = #{id} AND account.`is_deleted` = 0
